title: Stochastic MeanFlow Policies: One-Step Generative Control with Entropic Mirror Descent
abstract: arXiv:2605.21282v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Combining entropy regularisation with mirror descent in online off-policy reinforcement learning requires expressive policies with efficient sampling and explicit entropy control. Gaussian policies struggle to represent multimodal targets, whereas generative policies often require iterative sampling or lack tractable entropy estimates. We introduce Stochastic MeanFlow Policies (SMFP), a one-step generative policy class that combines MeanFlow-based noise-to-action mappings with Gaussian reparameterisation. The latent mapping captures diverse action modes, while a learnable conditional Gaussian scale provides an analytic entropy lower bound. We use this bound to regulate stochasticity alongside direct value guidance and advantage-weighted MeanFlow regression, enabling entropy-regularised mirror-descent learning with one-step policies. translated_title: 随机MeanFlow策略：基于熵镜像下降的单步生成式控制
translated_abstract: 在在线离策略强化学习中，将熵正则化与镜像下降相结合，需要既具备高效采样能力又能显式控制熵的表达性策略。高斯策略难以表示多模态目标，而生成式策略通常需要迭代采样或缺乏可处理的熵估计。我们提出了随机MeanFlow策略，这是一种单步生成式策略类别，它将基于MeanFlow的噪声到动作映射与高斯重参数化相结合。潜在映射能够捕捉多样化的动作模式，而可学习的条件高斯尺度则提供了具有解析形式的熵下界。我们利用该下界来调控随机性，并结合直接价值引导和优势加权的MeanFlow回归，从而实现基于单步策略的熵正则化镜像下降学习。在七个MuJoCo基准测试中，SMFP相较于高斯策略和生成式策略取得了强劲的性能表现。
tldr: SMFP是一种将MeanFlow噪声到动作映射与高斯重参数化相结合的单步生成式策略，通过解析熵下界实现熵正则化镜像下降强化学习，在七个MuJoCo基准上优于高斯策略和其他生成式策略。
en_tdlr: SMFP is a one-step generative policy class combining MeanFlow-based noise-to-action mappings with Gaussian reparameterization, enabling entropy-regularized mirror-descent reinforcement learning through an analytic entropy lower bound, and achieving strong performance over Gaussian and generative policies across seven MuJoCo benchmarks.
